## Description

Encounter step "Brief": left verified chart (problems, last labs, meds with verification, today's vitals), right "AI summary · not reviewed" (dashed violet) with 3–5 bullets each linking to its source (e.g. "Urine microalbumin was not done as ordered (lab PDF p.2)"). Generated before the visit from structured chart data; never mixed with verified styling.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Every AI bullet links to a source record; bullets without a source are not shown.
- [ ] **AC2.** The AI panel is visually distinct (violet dashed, label) and never styled as verified.
- [ ] **AC3.** If AI is unavailable the brief shows verified data only with a notice.
- [ ] **AC4.** Brief generation respects relationship/purpose authorisation and is audited.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
